search.title: Search for cameras
search.description: Searches the network Home Assistant is on. To also check another VLAN or subnet, enter it below (for example 192.168.6.0/24).

credentials.title: Log in to {host}
credentials.description: Leave the password blank if the camera has none.

discovery_confirm.title: Set up camera at {host}
discovery_confirm.description: Home Assistant found this Xiongmai camera. Enter its login to add it.

manual.title: Camera address
manual.description: Connects to the camera's DVRIP port (usually 34567). Leave the password blank if the camera has none.

reconfigure_auth.title: Camera login rejected
reconfigure_auth.description: Enter the camera's current username and password.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the camera on that host and port.
error.invalid_auth: The camera says the password is wrong. If you've never set one, leave it blank.
error.no_devices_found: No new cameras found. Check the subnet, or enter the address manually.
error.invalid_subnet: Enter a subnet like 192.168.6.0/24 (up to 1024 addresses).
error.locked: The camera has locked out logins after too many failed attempts. Wait about 30 minutes, or reboot the camera, then try again with the correct password.
error.unknown_user: That username doesn't exist on the camera (it's usually admin).

abort.already_configured: This camera is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: This camera is already being set up.

get_config.name: Get camera config
get_config.description: Read a raw configuration section (e.g. Simplify.Encode) or capability (e.g. EncodeCapability) from the camera.

name.name: Section
name.description: Config or capability name, e.g. AVEnc.VideoWidget.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: config for settings, ability for capabilities.

set_config.name: Set camera config
set_config.description: Write a whole raw configuration section. Read it with Get camera config first and send back the edited value.

data.name: Data
data.description: The full section value to write.
